items.message: The `_located_without_importing` fallback uses `find_spec` then iterates `spec.submodule_search_locations`, returning the first entry. `submodule_search_locations` on a namespace package or a `.pth`-manipulated sys.path can contain attacker-influenced strings if the environment's `sys.path` has been poisoned before this runs. This is a lower-severity concern, but the resolved `Path` is later used to open `pack.toml` (inferred from `found.manifest()` in the test), so a path that resolves outside …[truncated]

The fix is correct and the finding it closes is real: the previous identity test `prefixes is DENY_ALWAYS` meant that any caller constructing a new tuple — even one strictly extending `DENY_ALWAYS` — silently dropped the basename and suffix guards for `conftest.py`, `*.pem`, `.env*`, and `sitecustomize.py`. The new `always` flag is passed only by `ChangeGuard.check_path` for the tier-1 call, which is the right shape. No remaining concern on this path from what I can see in the diff.
